description: Use this when the buyer is interested in one bouquet from the search results: what is inside, its size, photos, the florist's rating, the price with delivery (exact for a street address — delivery_fee_exact says so; otherwise the shop's typical fee) and every time it can arrive on a given day. Needs a bouquet_id as search results show it. Covers one bouquet at a time.

date.description: Delivery/pickup day: 'today', 'tomorrow' or YYYY-MM-DD (Prague). Omit for as soon as possible.

fulfilment.description: delivery (default) or pickup at the florist's shop.

locale.description: The buyer's language for names, texts and links: cs, en, ru or uk (default cs).

where.description: Where the flowers go, as the buyer said it: a Prague district ('Praha 5'), a quarter ('Vinohrady', 'Smíchov') or a street address. Omit when unknown.

name: pinflower_get_bouquet
title: Bouquet details and times
